models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Preserves your LiteLLM alias; the official DeepSeek API calls this model deepseek-flash. Output uses the published 384K ceiling; reduce it for a smaller context reserve.

models.name: GLM 5.3 Flash
models.description: GLM 5.3 Flash with low/high/max reasoning. Uses a 1M context and 128K output cap from the referenced serving catalog; confirm your LiteLLM deployment supports these limits.

models.name: GLM 5.3
models.description: GLM 5.3 with low/high/max reasoning. Uses a 1M context and 128K output cap from the referenced serving catalog; confirm your LiteLLM deployment supports these limits.

models.name: Kimi K3
models.description: Kimi K3 with always-on thinking. The 131072 output cap is its documented API default, not its larger provider ceiling; this avoids reserving the whole context in Bello Agent.

models.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
models.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash. Uses Google's 1048576 input limit conservatively as the app context capacity, with a 65536 output cap. Minimal and off are not offered.

models.name: Auto Router — GPT-5.6 Sol + DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.description: Your LiteLLM router alias. Context and output use the lower limits of GPT-5.6 Sol and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash; effort choices are their common native labels. This entry does not configure the router.
